summary: HS 250 cm, 39 deg treeline pit at 2353 m (aspect blank), only 110-250 cm dug: tapered 1F-to-4F base (110-135), 4F 135-145, 1F 145-165, thin 4F 165-167, tapered 1F-to-4F 167-219, thin 1F 219-220 and F surface snow 220-250; ECTP30 on a 'Jan 24th' FC layer at 145 cm (FC under a thin MFC per notes); no grain forms
reading_issues: Full-page Propagation Labs PNG, mirrored layout, no grain table and no temperature profile. Heights from 10 cm gridlines (9.6 px/cm; HS 250 at y=355.5, blue PIT 110 line at y=1699): the lower 110 cm of snowpack is not dug. Header aspect is '--' (blank) and the filename gives only 'TL', so aspect is null. Two layers have sloped hardness bars (layer mean). The ECTP30 yellow line (145 cm) hides about 0.5 cm of the bar, so a very thin crust there ('thin MFC' in the notes) cannot be seen; no MFC layer is drawn in the bars and none is recorded. ECTP30 is given with taps 30 and propagation P; no failure depth label other than the line. Failure-layer grain (FC) and the name 'Jan 24th' come only from the test label. Confidence medium because the 'thin MFC' above the FC could not be placed.
